title: Manchester's mill district Rising Revisited
author: Wren Thornbury
blurb: Bram Zhou, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
